rendered: Lead or lead oxide makes up 70%[1] of a lead-acid cell's mass. Active cathode material is 30%[2] of a Li-ion (NMC622) cell's weight. So the lead-acid share is about 2.3[3] times the Li-ion cathode share. Both shares are approximate in the source, so the ratio is approximate.
